evidence: The machine features a triggerless handle with a red front comfort strip and an integrated wand tool release, identifying it as a non-catalogue Dyson Gen5detect.
contradictions: The machine lacks the finger trigger of the V15 Detect and the top-mounted power button and slim body of the V12 Detect Slim.

candidate_checks.evidence: Target is a handheld cordless stick vacuum rather than a canister vacuum on a ball.
Target has full-sized cyclone body proportions and lacks the top-mounted power button of the V12 Detect Slim.
Target visibly lacks a finger trigger in the handle crook, which contradicts the trigger-operated V15 Detect.
Target has a standard in-line bin rather than the CleanCompaktor compression assembly of the V16 Piston Animal.
Target uses an in-line horizontal bin layout rather than the perpendicular bin of the V8.
Target is a dry cordless vacuum rather than a twin-roller upright wet cleaner with water tanks.
